gecko.reasoning_trace: Stage 1 established a baseline force of 1.3 N based on the closest matching clean plastic object (smooth_screw_box). Stage 2 adjusted this baseline upward to account for the reduced projected contact fraction (0.48) using within-surface contact variation data, yielding a final estimated normal force of 2.944 N for the gecko gripper.

comparison_evidence: Surface material is clean, dry, smooth plastic which is highly compatible with gecko dry adhesives.
recommendation_summary: The gecko gripper is recommended because the surface is a clean, smooth, nonporous plastic which is ideal for gecko dry-adhesive pads. This results in a significantly lower required normal force (2.944 N) compared to the silicone gripper (5.324 N), making the gecko grasp more efficient.
